description: The all-time statistics of one Service or Datasource. The field names are the ones ESS uses, and a figure that ESS also sends is the same.

offers_count.description: Published Offers of the Service now.

service_opinion_count.description: Opinions: ratings that users gave the Service after using it.

project_items_count.description: Project items of the Service's Offers: Orders and open access Project items alike.

usage_counts_views.description: Views: displays of the Service's page, read from Matomo. null when this Node doesn't track Views (Matomo or its view sync is off), which differs from 0, no Views.

usage_counts_downloads.description: Orders: Project items whose Offer required an order when they were created, internal or external, in any status. Open access Project items aren't Orders.
